name: analyze_layout
title: Analyze the layout
description: Analyzes, without changing anything, the geometry, resources, styles, typography (local overrides, unstyled text, inconsistent point sizes and leadings) and deviations from a layout contract; returns a stable, reusable fingerprint.

name: compare_layout_snapshot
title: Compare a layout fingerprint
description: Computes the layout fingerprint again and compares it with a reference fingerprint to check a round trip.

name: create_document
title: Create a document
description: Creates an InDesign document with explicit dimensions, margins and bleed; returns documentId, revision and stateToken. With path, saves it at once as INDD (never overwriting) so that run_layout_script can then save with save=true.

name: create_working_copy
title: Create a working copy
description: Silently creates and opens a working INDD copy from a verified backup, then proves that the source document stayed unchanged.

name: execute_uxp_silent
title: Run UXP silently
description: Runs synchronous or asynchronous UXP JavaScript without a panel. Checks revision and stateToken and backs up every open document. UXP does not guarantee an atomic undo; use silent_restore_backup. This free code can reach files and the network.

expectedStateToken.description: Token returned by silent_inspect_document just before the change.

name: export_idml
title: Export IDML
description: Exports the document as IDML to an allowed path, without a dialog, then checks the structure of the package produced.

name: export_pdf
title: Export PDF
description: Exports a PDF to an allowed file at the requested revision.

name: export_png
title: Export PNG
description: Exports one page to filePath, or several pages to folderPath, with no ambiguity about the target.

name: finalize_layout
title: Finalize the layout
description: Runs the contract diagnosis and the Adobe preflight, then exports a verified PDF only when no blocking deviation is found.

name: get_document_info
title: Inspect the document
description: Silently reads the document properties and its current revision.

name: get_fonts
title: Check fonts
description: Silently lists the fonts used and reports the missing ones.

name: get_images
title: Inspect images
description: Silently lists the images with link, format and effective resolution.

name: get_links
title: Check links
description: Silently lists the links, statuses, paths and effective resolutions.

name: get_overset_text
title: Detect overset text
description: Silently detects the text frames with overset text.

name: indesign_doctor
title: Diagnose the available capabilities
description: Checks locally the runtime, the private storage, both channels and the registry integrity without starting or contacting InDesign. Can include the compact detail of each tool.

includeTools.description: Includes the name, route, safety flags and schema hash of each tool.

name: list_pages
title: List pages
description: Silently lists the pages and their ids.

name: open_document
title: Open a document
description: Silently opens an allowed INDD or IDML file; returns documentId, revision and stateToken.

name: package_document
title: Package the document
description: Creates an InDesign package in an allowed folder.

name: preflight_document
title: Preflight the document
description: Silently runs the prepress preflight and returns the structured errors without changing the document.

name: preview_layout
title: Preview the layout
description: Produces a verified multipage PNG preview (thumbnails attached to the answer), annotated on request from a hidden copy, and attaches the matching layout diagnosis.

annotate.description: Renders the preview from a hidden annotated copy (frame ids, margins, columns, overset text in red); the source document stays unchanged.

name: run_layout_script
title: Quick layout script
description: The normal way to change a document: in a single InDesign pass, checks revision and stateToken, backs up every open document (restorable with silent_restore_backup), runs the UXP code (app, indesign, doc, input; return to send back a value), saves when save=true, exports a checked PNG preview (thumbnail attached to the answer), then closes when close=true (with save=true). The changes made before the first await form a single InDesign undo step named "Nexus: <reason>". Returns the new revision and the new stateToken: chain calls without inspecting again. A failed script returns scriptOk=false, the error, the preview and backupId without blocking what follows. This free code can reach files and the network.

expectedStateToken.description: Token returned by open_document, silent_inspect_document or the previous call.

save.description: Saves the document after a successful script.

close.description: Closes the document after saving and previewing; needs save=true.

previewPages.description: Pages to render (InDesign names, e.g. "1" or "2-3"); the first page by default.

name: save_as
title: Save as
description: Saves the document to a new allowed INDD path (safety copy of the existing target when overwrite=true) after checking revision and stateToken and backing up every open document.

name: save_document
title: Save the document
description: Saves the document at its current location after checking revision and stateToken and backing up every open document; returns the new stateToken. A document never saved needs save_as.

name: search_official_dom
title: Search the official Adobe DOM
description: Searches offline for a class or an enumeration in the pinned official Adobe DOM index and returns the exact reference links.

name: silent_audit_document
title: Fully audit a document without a panel
description: Reads in a single structured call the pages, items, links, fonts, images, overset text and styles. The answer explicitly reports any truncation due to the item count or the result limit.

name: silent_close_document
title: Close without saving and without a panel
description: Closes only the identified document with save=false, after an exact check of revision and stateToken. Does not save and makes no copy of the document.

name: silent_inspect_document
title: Inspect a document without a panel
description: Reads the essential properties, the revision and the stateToken of the real content. Reuse revision and stateToken for any silent write.

name: silent_list_documents
title: List documents without a panel
description: Lists the open documents and their revisions through the local silent channel.

name: silent_operation_status
title: Reconcile a silent operation
description: Reads the private result of an operation that timed out. A missing or pending result always means inspecting the document again.

name: silent_reconcile_unknown_operation
title: Secure, then acknowledge an unknown outcome
description: After a crash or a disconnection, checks that InDesign is stable and not modal, backs up every document, keeps a private evidence, then releases the orphaned lock. Never infers a false success.

name: silent_restore_backup
title: Restore a silent copy
description: Restores a verified INDD copy created by the silent channel. First backs up every open document, then replaces the target document without saving it. Needs revision and stateToken read just before.

name: silent_status
title: Test InDesign without a panel
description: Queries InDesign 19 to 21 directly through COM and UXP, without a panel, click, network or Computer Use.
